{{Current events|year=2018|month=12|day=15|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Kashmir conflict]]
**[[Indian Army|Indian soldiers]] and counterinsurgency police exchange gunfire with militants in the southern district of [[Pulwama district|Pulwama]], resulting in the deaths of one soldier and three militants. The soldiers then opened fire on a crowd of anti-government protesters who gathered after the battle, killing seven civilians and injuring 40 others. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/asia/kashmir-india-protests-militants-civilians-killed-pakistan-a8685116.html (''The Independent'')]

;International relations
*[[Australia–Israel relations]]
**[[Australia]] formally recognizes [[West Jerusalem]] as the capital of [[Israel]] and [[East Jerusalem]] as the capital of a future [[Palestinians|Palestinian]] state but will not move its embassy from [[Tel Aviv]] until a peace settlement is reached with the [[State of Palestine|Palestinians]]. [https://news.sky.com/story/australia-recognises-west-jerusalem-as-capital-of-israel-11581432 (Sky News)]
*[[2018 United Nations Climate Change Conference]]
**Representatives from 196 nations [[United Nations Climate Change conference|agree]] on a rulebook to implement the [[Paris Agreement]] for [[climate change mitigation]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-climate-change-accord/nations-agree-global-climate-pact-rules-after-overcoming-impasse-idUSKBN1OE0N9 (Reuters)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/science-environment-46582025 (BBC)]
*[[Afghanistan–Pakistan relations]]
**Pakistani, Afghan and [[China|Chinese]] officials hold talks in [[Kabul]] aimed at ending the region's conflicts. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2018/12/afghanistan-hosts-talks-pakistan-china-181215073252236.html (Al Jazeera)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2018 Sri Lankan constitutional crisis]]
**[[Mahinda Rajapaksa]] resigns as [[Prime Minister of Sri Lanka|prime minister]], effectively ending the constitutional crisis. [https://www.bbc.com/news/amp/world-asia-46571195 (BBC)]
*[[2018 Moscow–Constantinople schism]]
**[[President of Ukraine]] [[Petro Poroshenko]] declares the establishment of the [[Orthodox Church of Ukraine]], a new branch of [[Eastern Orthodox Christianity]], separate from the [[Russian Orthodox Church]], after Ukrainian clergy elected Metropolitan [[Epiphanius I (Metropolitan of Kyiv)|Epiphanius I]] as the head of the new church. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-46575548 (BBC)] [https://www.unian.info/politics/10378413-metropolitan-epifaniy-elected-head-of-local-ukrainian-orthodox-church-photo-video.html (UNIAN)] [http://tass.com/society/1036258 (TASS)] 
*[[Cabinet of Donald Trump]]
**[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] tweets that [[United States Secretary of the Interior|Secretary of the Interior]] [[Ryan Zinke]] will quit his post at the end of the year. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-trump-zinke/as-zinke-departs-trump-says-he-will-name-new-interior-secretary-next-week-idUSKBN1OE0I3 (Reuters)]
